subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: After the policy source is unified and exact-head behavior is proven, should CodexBar permanently ship and maintain `AdaptiveReplayCLI` as a SwiftPM product?
rationale: The accepted adaptive-refresh work approved an opt-in runtime policy and evidence gate, but it did not establish ownership of a standalone executable and substantial analysis subsystem.

options.title: Sponsor shared-policy tooling
options.body: Accept the executable after runtime and replay consume one canonical policy implementation and current-head behavior is demonstrated.

options.title: Accept mirrored tooling
options.body: Explicitly own parallel policy implementations and the continuing platform-specific parity-test burden.

options.title: Keep tooling external
options.body: Retain the research results without adopting permanent replay targets in CodexBar.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared-policy tooling
recommendation.body: Accept the executable after runtime and replay consume one canonical policy implementation and current-head behavior is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository product and package ownership is the unresolved choice, and current-main history provides the strongest decision-routing signal.
